info.name: AWS IoT Events Alarm Models API
info.description:
AWS IoT Events monitors your equipment or device fleets for failures or changes in operation, and triggers actions when such events occur. You can use AWS IoT Events API operations to create, read, update, and delete inputs and detector models, and to list their versions.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mike Ralphson
 Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com

item.name: Amazon IoT Events Delete Alarm Model

variable.description: (Required) The name of the alarm model.

request.description: Deletes an alarm model. Any alarm instances that were created based on this alarm model are also deleted. This action can't be undone.
